title: Impact of Dividend Initiation on Stock Returns

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
For this research question, an Event Study approach is suitable. The Event Study method is used to measure the impact of a specific event (in this case, the announcement of dividend initiation) on the stock returns. The key assumption here is that the stock returns are not affected by other events around the same time, and the abnormal returns can be attributed to the dividend initiation announcement.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load necessary libraries
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(plm)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s53_data.csv")

# Calculate abnormal returns
data$abnormal_ret <- data$ret - data$mkt_ret * data$beta

# Define the event window (-10 to 0) and estimation window (-10 to -11)
data$event_window <- ifelse(data$event_day >= -10 & data$event_day <= 0, 1, 0)
data$estimation_window <- ifelse(data$event_day >= -11 & data$event_day <= -10, 1, 0)

# Estimate the model for the estimation window
estimation_model <- plm(abnormal_ret ~ event_day, data = data[data$estimation_window == 1,], model = "within")

# Estimate the model for the event window
event_model <- plm(abnormal_ret ~ event_day, data = data[data$event_window == 1,], model = "within")

# Calculate the cumulative abnormal return (CAR) for the event window
car <- coeftest(event_model, vcovHC(estimation_model, type = "HC1"))

# Print the result
print(car)
```

## 3. Expected Findings
We expect the cumulative abnormal return (CAR) to be negative on the announcement day (event_day = 0). This is because the market may react negatively to the dividend initiation announcement, as it could signal that the company is not reinvesting its profits back into the business, which could lead to lower future growth prospects. The magnitude of the CAR will depend on the specific circumstances of each dividend initiation announcement, but a negative CAR would be consistent with the market's negative reaction to such announcements.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Compare CAR on announcement day to pre-announcement days.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Dividend initiation announcements lead to a negative CAR on the announcement day.
